title: DeepParse: canonical output compliance harness for streaming & toolcall edgecases
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a focused test harness (DeepParse) that validates end-to-end structured-output compliance across streaming responses, intermediate tool/function calls, and constrained-decoder fallbacks. This ticket covers corpus generation, deterministic replay for partial-stream reassembly, and a compatibility matrix across model variants (fp16/int8/q4). The harness should simulate network chunking, mid-response tool returns, and API-level backoff so we can assert schema adherence and graceful degradation paths.
acceptance_criteria: Automated suite that reproduces partial-streaming JSON fragments and confirms reassembly into valid canonical envelopes with schema validation (>= 95% pass on synthetic corpus).
Simulated tool/function-calls mid-stream with injected anomalies (missing fields, extra array items) and verification of contract fallback behaviour documented in runbooks.
Constrained-decoder tests that exercise n-best/backoff flows and verify decoder preserves required typed fields under quantized models.
Compatibility matrix runs (minimum 3 model variants x 2 sequence length profiles x 2 quantization profiles) produce pass/fail dashboard rows integrated into CI.
Clear PR template and runbook with rollback steps if regression detected in runtime-1.21 canary.
test_plan: Corpus generation: derive 1k prompts from real prompt-sets + synthetic edgecases (truncation, nested arrays, large number fields).
Chunking simulator: produce random mid-token cut points and stream reassembly harness to feed the constrained decoder.
Tool-call emulator: stubbed tool responses with schema violations and delayed acknowledgements to validate function-calling recovery.
Fuzz harness: mutation-based fuzzing for field types and order permutations, log all failures to Sentry with repro vector.
CI integration: nightly compatibility job that uploads results to dashboards and artifacts to Google Drive.
